edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: children or adults receiving probiotic supplementation
edges.mechanism: BB-12 is mainly being tested as a mucosal-immune adjuvant: the pediatric trials report higher salivary IgA or shifts in gut community stability rather than a sterilizing effect on infection exposure itself.
edges.summary: The clearest signal comes from the 2021 DI Pierro trial, where children given a BB-12-containing probiotic mix had fewer upper respiratory infections over 90 days than untreated controls. The newer BB-12 literature points in the same direction, but the better read is milder or shorter respiratory illness rather than guaranteed prevention of every episode.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.

evidence.notes: Lactoferrin combined with Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis BB-12 improves respiratory tract infections and modulates Gut microbiome function in children: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.

Use of a probiotic mixture containing Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis BB-12 and Enterococcus faecium L3 as prophylaxis to reduce the incidence of acute gastroenteritis and upper respiratory tract infections in children.
[The effectiveness of BIFIFORM KIDS in the prevention of the incidence of acute respiratory infections in children].
